statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id:$AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(n:AWSInternetGateway) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND coalesce(n.ownerid, $AWS_ID) = $AWS_ID WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Only a gateway this account owns: one shared into it (RAM, another account's VPC) is the owner's to delete

statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:AWSAccount{id:$AWS_ID})-[r:RESOURCE]->(:AWSInternetGateway) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Stale claims, e.g. the RESOURCE edges an account used to take to gateways shared into it
